conventions.money: Integer US cents. Field names end in `_cents`.
conventions.time: UTC, ISO 8601, second precision. Local times are for display only.
conventions.windows: Half-open [start, end). At `expires_at` the object is already expired.
conventions.clock: The world clock is logical. Every call advances it by the action's declared time cost, reads included, so repeated searching cannot freeze a deadline. `time_cost_s` in a result is the exact world time from the start of the call to its commit, waiting included. When a call ends the episode, the run of the clock to the observation end is not counted as the call's.
conventions.ordering: Accepted writes get a global sequence number `seq`. Events at the same instant are ordered by (time, priority, id).
conventions.idempotency: Write actions require `request_id`. A repeated key returns the first result.
conventions.identity: The actor comes from the seat credential. Every endpoint checks role and object ownership.
conventions.commitments: Proposals, orders, authorizations and quotes are world objects. Free text never commits anyone.

roles.name: ota_agent
roles.title: Booking agent
roles.description: Works for the travel agency. Sees all flights, fares and the orders it created. Does not know the travellers' private preferences and cannot move money or cancel without their authorization.

roles.name: traveler
roles.title: Traveller
roles.description: Holds private preferences, a budget and payment methods. Can search read-only, answer questions, accept or reject proposals and grant authorizations. Cannot book.

actions.name: list_airports
actions.summary: List airports, with coordinates, time zone and metro area.

actions.name: search_policy
actions.summary: Find passages in the policy documents.
actions.description: Word search over the rules this world applies. Passages state amounts and deadlines exactly as the world enforces them.
actions.visibility: The agent searches the agency handbook. A traveller searches the customer terms.

actions.name: search_flights
actions.summary: Search one-way itineraries and get priced offers.
actions.description: Returns nonstop and one-connection itineraries that leave on `date`, at the times the flights have now, and respect the minimum connection time. Offers expire after 20 minutes, or when sales close 60 minutes before the first departure, whichever comes first. `passengers` above 1 prices everyone from one fare bucket, so two seats may cost more each than one seat.

actions.name: get_offer
actions.summary: Read one offer with its fare conditions.

actions.name: get_seat_map
actions.summary: Seat availability and seat fees for one flight.

actions.name: get_flight_status
actions.summary: Current status of a flight: scheduled, delayed, cancelled, departed or arrived, with its current times.

actions.name: price_offer
actions.summary: Confirm an offer's price and availability before booking.
actions.description: Reserves nothing. Returns the offer at its current price with a fresh expiry, never later than the close of sales, 60 minutes before the first departure. The offer keeps its identifier. A proposal made at the earlier price cannot be executed any more.

actions.name: create_proposal
actions.summary: Put a concrete plan in front of the travellers.
actions.description: A proposal names one offer per traveller and who pays how much. The world adds the seat and bag fees and fixes each traveller's total. Travellers accept it and authorise against it. An offer priced for several passengers must be given to exactly that many travellers. Every offer must still sell at its stated fare, taking the offers in the order given. Creating a new proposal for the same travellers supersedes the earlier one.
actions.visibility: Visible to the agent and to every traveller named in it.

actions.name: get_proposal
actions.summary: Read a proposal and the travellers' responses.
actions.visibility: The agent and the travellers named in it.

actions.name: execute_proposal
actions.summary: Carry out a proposal: charge the payers and ticket every order in it.
actions.description: All or nothing. Every offer in the proposal must be unexpired and still sell at the proposal's fare; otherwise the call fails with `PRICE_CHANGED` or `SOLD_OUT` and a new proposal is needed. Each payment consumes one authorization for this proposal. A payer's payments must add up to exactly their share in the proposal, and every traveller named in it must be among the grantors, even at zero. The result is one ticketed order per offer. A payer's money goes first to the order they travel on, then to the others.
actions.visibility: The orders are visible to the agent and to every traveller named in the proposal.

actions.name: hold_order
actions.summary: Hold an offer unpaid, if its fare allows it.
actions.description: Takes the seats at the offer's fare until `payment_required_by`. No money moves and no consent is needed. Pay with `pay_order`, with authorizations for the order. A hold that is not paid in time is cancelled by the world and its seats are released.

actions.name: pay_order
actions.summary: Pay a held order and issue the tickets.
actions.description: Each payment consumes one authorization whose subject is this order at its current version. Every passenger must be among the grantors, even at zero.

actions.name: get_order
actions.summary: Read an order: status, payments, seats, airline changes.
actions.visibility: The agent that created it, and travellers who are passengers or payers on it.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.summary: List the orders visible to this seat.

actions.name: update_order_services
actions.summary: Assign seats and add checked bags.
actions.description: Free choices need no authorization. Paid ones need one from the paying traveller for this order version. A passenger may appear once per flight in `seat_assignments` and once in `bags`. Passengers of one order can swap seats in a single call.

actions.name: search_change_options
actions.summary: Price the ways an order could be moved to another itinerary.
actions.description: Options keep the carrier and the fare brand and connect the same two metro areas. Each one states the change fee, the fare difference and the net amount due, which is negative when money comes back. With `airline_change_id` the options are the free rebooking that change entitles to: on the scheduled date or the day after, any seat left, nothing to pay.

actions.name: get_change_offer
actions.summary: Read one change offer.
actions.visibility: The agent and everyone who can see the order.

actions.name: confirm_change
actions.summary: Carry out a change offer.
actions.description: All or nothing. The order must not have changed since the offer was made and the new itinerary must still sell at the offer's fare. Each payment consumes one authorization for this change offer; every passenger must be among the grantors. Seats are released and must be chosen again; seat fees already paid are not returned. Bags stay.

actions.name: quote_cancellation
actions.summary: Ask what cancelling an order would refund, to whom and under which rule.
actions.description: Changes nothing. Without `airline_change_id` the quote follows the agency's 24-hour policy if the order is still inside its window, and the fare conditions otherwise. With it, the quote is the full refund that airline change entitles to. The two can differ a lot. The world does not pick for you, but an ordinary quote names the open airline change in `full_refund_available` when there is one.

actions.name: get_cancellation_quote
actions.summary: Read one cancellation quote.
actions.visibility: The agent and everyone who can see the order.

actions.name: confirm_cancellation
actions.summary: Cancel as quoted and refund the payers.
actions.description: All or nothing. The order must not have changed since the quote. Every passenger must have authorised this quote. Refunds go to whoever paid for each passenger's ticket.

actions.name: split_order
actions.summary: Move some travellers to an order of their own.
actions.description: Needed before changing or cancelling for only some travellers of a shared order. Nobody's flights or money change, so no authorization is needed. Each passenger's account, payments, seat, bags and ticket move with them. A pending airline change is carried over to the new order under a new identifier.

actions.name: accept_airline_change
actions.summary: Confirm that the travellers will fly the schedule the airline changed to.
actions.description: Only for a change that lists `accept` among its options. To rebook at no charge, search change options with the change's identifier and confirm one. To take the refund, quote the cancellation with the change's identifier and confirm it. If nobody responds by `respond_by`, the travellers fly as rescheduled when that is possible, and are refunded in full when it is not.

actions.name: get_my_profile
actions.summary: This traveller's passenger details.

actions.name: get_my_wallet
actions.summary: This traveller's payment methods and what is available on each.

actions.name: respond_to_proposal
actions.summary: Accept or reject the agent's proposal.
actions.description: Accepting states agreement with the plan. It moves no money; that takes an authorization.

actions.name: grant_authorization
actions.summary: Let the agent act on one specific subject, up to a charge ceiling.
actions.description: Single-use. The subject is a proposal, an order, a change offer, a cancellation quote or an airline change. The world stores a digest of the subject as it is now; if it changes afterwards, the authorization no longer matches and cannot be used.

actions.name: revoke_authorization
actions.summary: Withdraw an authorization that has not been used.

actions.name: list_authorizations
actions.summary: List authorizations granted by this traveller, or granted to this agent.

actions.name: send_message
actions.summary: Send a message to one or more seats.
actions.description: Free text plus typed attachments. To make an offer, create the world object first and attach a reference to it; a price written in text commits nobody.
actions.visibility: Delivered only to the named recipients. The board sets `sender`.

actions.name: read_inbox
actions.summary: Read unread messages, optionally waiting for the next one.
actions.description: With `wait_minutes` the world clock advances while the seat sleeps. The wait ends early when a message or an event notice for this seat arrives, and it never runs past the end of the observation period.
actions.visibility: Only messages addressed to this seat.

actions.name: get_message_history
actions.summary: Page through earlier messages of this seat.
actions.visibility: Only messages this seat sent or received.

actions.name: finish
actions.summary: Hand back control and end this seat's session.
actions.description: Finishing does not stop the world. Pending holds, deadlines and scheduled events still settle until the task's observation end, with nobody acting for this seat.

passages.section: Airline changes: cancelled flights and broken connections
passages.text: When a flight of an order is cancelled, or a delay leaves less than the minimum connection time at the connecting airport, the travellers cannot fly as booked. They may rebook at no charge or take a full refund. If nobody responds by the deadline, the order is cancelled and everything paid for it is refunded to the original payment methods.

passages.section: Free rebooking and refunds after an airline change
passages.text: The free rebooking is an itinerary of the same carrier between the same two metro areas, scheduled on the original date or up to 1 day later, on any flight with seats left. It costs nothing and keeps the fare brand, the fare paid and the bags. The refund after an airline change returns everything paid for the order, fees for seats, bags and changes included, to the original payment methods. Both must be asked for by naming the airline change: a change or a cancellation asked for without it follows the ordinary fare conditions, which can return much less. A quote or a change offer made the ordinary way while such an airline change is open says so, and names the change to ask with.
